section: ### The map — where a reader enters, artifact by artifact

findings.statement: one row per gate — suite, rate + composition, survivors, last sweep + pin
findings.evidence: 9 recorded cases (`git ls-tree -r --name-only 8ca67421 | grep -c 'corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-'` -> 9) but only 8 rate rows: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md | grep -n '^## '` -> §1 :41 (rows :45-48), ER-2 (rows 5-6), '## Round 16 — seventh row appended' :403, '## Round 18 — eighth row appended' :424, and no ninth; `grep -n '5/10' <ledger>` -> :410 round-gate, :432 sources-check, nothing for cite-check. The round-26 ninth case records a measured 5/10 at `corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kumitate-cite-check.md:44` and states the gap itself: 'The standing ledger fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md still lists cite-check as a four-defect probe (1/4) ... The ledger file is not edited this round' (:123-126).

proposed_fix.skill_old: one row per gate — suite, rate + composition, survivors, last sweep + pin
proposed_fix.skill_new: one row per gate measured so far — suite, rate + composition, survivors, last sweep + pin (eight rows; the round-26 ninth case has no row yet)
proposed_fix.why: The ledger holds eight rate rows for nine measured gates at base. Preferred repair is the substantive one: append the round-26 ninth row to the ledger, which makes the original cell true unchanged; this cell edit is the fallback if the ledger is left as-is. Deletes no pointer.

findings.statement: before quoting any rate — the row is the standing receipt
findings.evidence: Same root: the round-26 rate (5/10, `corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kumitate-cite-check.md:44`) has no ledger row — `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md | grep -n -i 'cite-check'` -> :94 (round-6 probe, 1/4) and :107 (queue row 'probe only'), no rate row; `grep -n 'round 26' <ledger>` -> no match. A reader following this instruction for that rate finds no standing receipt.

findings.statement: request shape, the re-pin rule, read-only guarantees, report shape, boundaries
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/service-optin-protocol.md | grep -n '^## '` -> §0 offer :16, §1 Request shape :54, §2 Read-only guarantees :109, §3 Owner-hardens discipline :142, §4 Report shape :182, §5 precedents :220, §6 :239, §7 :257, §8 errata :276. No section and no clause is titled or scoped 'boundaries': `grep -n -i boundar <file>` -> :168 ('a harness boundary'), :177 ('harden the boundary classes') — class terms inside §2/§3, not a held section. The request-shape re-pin item is §1.1 (:60-63). The list also omits §3 owner-hardens, which the lane's own artifact table names as one of the protocol's four holds (`corpus/knowledge/service-standing-state.md:56`: 'request shape (§1), guarantees (§2), owner-hardens (§3), report shape (§4)').

proposed_fix.skill_old: request shape, the re-pin rule, read-only guarantees, report shape, boundaries
proposed_fix.skill_new: request shape (§1, including the re-pin rule), read-only guarantees (§2), the owner-hardens rule (§3), report shape (§4)
proposed_fix.why: Names the four holds the lane's own boundary table records, keeps the re-pin rule, drops the 'boundaries' item that no section of the file carries, and adds none of the missing §3 without a pointer. Adds no pointer.

findings.statement: per-case spec, verdict table, survivor probes, reproduce sections
findings.evidence: `for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only 8ca67421 | grep 'corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-'); do git show 8ca67421:$f | grep -c -i '^## .*reproduce'; done` -> kagi-census 1, kagi-checklist 1, kimi-census 1, kumitate-claims 1, mado-verify 1, tsukuroi-census 1, but kumitate-round-gate 0, kumitate-sources-check 0, kumitate-cite-check 0. `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kumitate-cite-check.md | grep -n '^## '` -> sections 0-5, last '## 5. Limits' :112: no reproduce section. Those three notes carry '## 1. Pre-registration' and cite a committed spec instead.

proposed_fix.skill_old: per-case spec, verdict table, survivor probes, reproduce sections
proposed_fix.skill_new: per-case spec (pre-registration in the round-16/18/26 notes), verdict table, survivor probes, reproduce sections where the note carries one
proposed_fix.why: Three of the nine notes have no reproduce section; the cell should not promise one. Deletes no pointer (the glob `corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-*.md` is untouched).

findings.statement: the coverage map — one row per note, holds + sources
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/README.md` parsed: 63 table rows total (main map :7-15, addendum :47-61, later round appends :127-587), 58 distinct targets; `corpus/knowledge` holds 58 note files, 57 have a row — `knowledge/r44-anchor-refresh-rule.md` has none — and five notes carry two rows each (gates-survey-kumitate, gates-survey-kagi, verification-patterns-fleet, witness-scoped-kill-verdict, incremental-pin-disposition). The columns are `Note | Holds | Sources`, but the map is not one row per note in either direction.

proposed_fix.skill_old: the coverage map — one row per note, holds + sources
proposed_fix.skill_new: the coverage map — a row per note carried, holds + sources (addenda append extra rows; coverage is partial, one knowledge note uncarried at this revision)
proposed_fix.why: Makes the shape true at base without adding a pointer: the duplicate addendum rows and the one uncovered note are named in prose, not as paths.

findings.statement: the completion pack (`plans/completion-evidence.md`, this wave, uncommitted at this write) collects the per-round lines and debts
findings.evidence: `git cat-file -e 8ca67421:plans/completion-evidence.md; echo rc=$?` -> rc=0 (present in the base tree); `git log --diff-filter=A --format='%h %s' -- plans/completion-evidence.md` -> '284ab0f probation round 11 (training r10, FINAL): closeout — the 10-round arc complete; see closeout-r11.md + completion-evidence.md'; last touch `cd31c6b` (fleet round 1). The pack has been committed since the round-11 closeout, so 'this wave, uncommitted at this write' is false at base. The content clause holds: `plans/completion-evidence.md:24` '## One line per round', `:68` '## Debts', 189 lines.

proposed_fix.skill_old: the completion pack (`plans/completion-evidence.md`, this wave, uncommitted at this write) collects the per-round lines and debts
proposed_fix.skill_new: the completion pack (`plans/completion-evidence.md`, committed in the round-11 closeout) collects the per-round lines and debts
proposed_fix.why: Drops a stale status sentence the reader cannot reproduce (it was true only inside the round-11 wave). Keeps the path pointer and the content claim; adds no pointer.

findings.statement: the operator's entry point (T10-1): §0 quick start · §2 the tool · §3 the six-case ledger · §4 opt-in · §5 limits · §6 the cadence (tick, reading map, T1–T3) · §7 the regression mode · §10 unknowns
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/operator-runbook.md | grep -n '^## '` -> §0 :35, §2 :93, §3 'The six-case ledger' :131, §4 :180, §5 :243, §6 'the cadence — the tick, the reading map, the triggers' :269, §7 :345, §10 :462; header ':1 (round 10, T10-1)'. §6 carries the reading map (:277) and T1/T2/T3 (:288/:290/:293). §3 holds exactly six rows (:149-154). Caveat, not a falsity: the lane has held nine cases since round 26 (`git ls-tree -r --name-only 8ca67421 | grep -c 'corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-'` -> 9), so the runbook's six-case ledger is stale as a lane view even though the cell describes the file correctly.

proposed_fix.skill_new: §3 the six-case ledger (six rows; the lane has held nine cases since round 26)
proposed_fix.why: Currency flag, not a correction of the cell: annotates the stale number inside the map so a reader entering the loop is not handed a six-case view of a nine-case service. Preferred repair is updating the runbook's §0/§3 instead; this edit is the fallback. Adds no pointer.

findings.evidence: `git rev-list --reverse 8ca67421 -- corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md` -> 9 commits; sha256 of the text between '## 1. Measured' and '## 5.' is `d2ae445332dd` at every one of the nine (script over `git show <rev>:corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md`), so §1–§4 never changed. Appends sit below §4 (:132): '## Round 16 — seventh row appended' :403, '## Round 18 — eighth row appended' :424; the ledger states the rule itself at :312 ('never as an edit of §1–§4').

findings.statement: the refusals, detail of record; this page carries the compact rendering (`:1246-1270`)
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/service-limits.md | grep -n '^## '` -> '§1. The decision table' :42 with ten refusal rows a-j (:46-55), '§2. Row detail — the measured reasons, verbatim' :57, '§3. The intake precondition — the re-pin rule' :172; `corpus/knowledge/service-standing-state.md:57` names the file 'refusal detail of record'. The `:1246-1270` clause is a SKILL.md line pointer and is left to the pointer readers.

findings.statement: the suite census: the offer and the queue (surveyed-but-unmeasured pins)
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/fleet-suite-census.md` -> '## 5. Tameshi's standing service offer' :249, the offer :269, 'Queue (projection, ordered by expected yield...)' :277-286, R.4 updated queue :594; pins for the surveyed-but-unmeasured gates sit in '§1.1 Identity and pins' :75-84 and in '§6 Boundary — beyond the six' :293-305 (kagi pins `275d8294…`/`078a2601…`). Note: the §5 queue table itself has no pin column (Gate | Static state | Why probe it | Sweep prerequisite), so the parenthetical is right about the file, not about the queue table.

findings.statement: the boundary note: fleet-visible vs lane-owned, handoff conditions, SC1–SC3
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:corpus/knowledge/service-standing-state.md | grep -n '^## \|SC[123]'` -> '## 1. Fleet-visible artifacts (the handed side)' :49, '## 2. Lane-owned (the withheld side)' :70, '## 3. The handoff conditions' :80, 'SC1 —' :159, 'SC2 —' :174, 'SC3 —' :181.

findings.statement: (six at round 11; seven since round 16; eight since round 18; nine since round 26)
findings.evidence: `for c in 284ab0f c699c8c 58e5d53 40a12bf 8ca67421; do git ls-tree -r --name-only $c | grep -c 'corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-'; done` -> 6 7 8 9 9. Add commits: round 16 `c699c8c` adds kumitate-round-gate (7th), round 18 `58e5d53` adds kumitate-sources-check (8th), round 26 `40a12bf` adds kumitate-cite-check (9th); the six at round 11 are the round-2/3/5/6/8 notes.

findings.statement: the instrument: `--selftest`, `--regression` (six-leg registry at round 11, seven since round 16, eight since round 18, nine since round 26; git-materialized replay)
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | grep -n 'r10-2 six legs'` -> :83 '--regression (r4-2; r7-1 leg ledger; r10-2 six legs; r16 seven; r18 eight; r26 nine)'; :108 'All nine defect specs are embedded below'; git materialization :115-120 and :1209 (`git show > file`; 'the target is NOT read from the fleet working tree'). Observed in a scratch clone: `TMPDIR=<scratch> bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --selftest` -> last lines 'MUTATE_SELFTEST: 106/106 pass' / 'VERDICT: PASS' (receipt `.ufo/waves/round-49/w1/T49SecMap.selftest.txt`).

findings.statement: each round's plan and record by convention (rounds 4–10); no separate round-11 record file exists
findings.evidence: `git ls-tree -r --name-only 8ca67421 | grep '^plans/'` -> plans/round-{4,5,6,7,8,9,10}.plan.md and plans/round-{4,5,6,7,8,9,10}-record-draft.md all present; `git ls-tree -r --name-only 8ca67421 | grep -i 'round-11'` -> only `plans/round-11.plan.md`, so no round-11 record file. (Plans for rounds 2, 3 and 11 exist as plans only, outside the stated rounds 4–10 convention; the parenthetical scopes the claim correctly.)

findings.statement: the round rows and the move-log rows with their counting commands
findings.evidence: `git show 8ca67421:SCORECARD.md | sed -n '7p'` -> '## Move log'; row 1 (:11) carries its counting commands ('`git show 40f8e1f:SKILL.md | wc -l` → 22; ...'); round sections run to '## Round 48' (:2320). LOG has round rows carrying executed outputs (e.g. :56 '`--selftest` → `SELFTEST: PASS (16 cases)`, exit 0') and points at the scorecard's commands (:49 'the SCORECARD round-1 counting commands').
